notes.title: New ability to simulate a call with AI & Fast scroll Up/Down in many screens
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=_SqoVn6nX9E;full][/previewyoutube]

Dear Players,
We’re excited to announce a new option added in World Diplomat.

You will now have the ability to simulate a call with a person in your network and ask them a question. 
If the person is real, the AI will gather available data about them from the internet and simulate their response, providing you with insights based on their known actions, words, and character. 
This action will cost 120 personal influence points.

With this new feature, you can communicate with world leaders, ministers, business leaders, and more. 
What questions will you ask using the power of AI?

* Also we added fast scroll Up/Down in many menus and screens.
* Improved game UI, speed, and stability.
* Fixed issues and continued to enhance artificial intelligence.

We plan to add countless new missions, scenarios, AI interactions, and diplomat economy options. 
Your support is important to us as we continue developing the game.
Thank you,
iGindis Team
